text: {"lessons":["I sold A, C, D, and E after gains, but my satisfaction at locking in profits is not a sound reason by itself; I should judge each trade by its role in my whole account.","My account rose overall while I held steady, despite a sizable dip along the way. That reminds me not to react to every monthly move, though it does not predict what prices will do next.","I should not treat each stock as a separate account or let average cost control my decisions: realizing a loss feels painful, but past purchase prices do not forecast future returns."]}
